questions.q: Which legendary queen is linked to the ancient kingdom of Saba in Yemen?
questions.why: The Bible says she visited Solomon.

questions.q: Which ancient dam in Yemen was one of the engineering wonders of the old world?
questions.why: Its collapse around 570 was legendary.

questions.q: Which port city was a British colony until 1967?
questions.why: It was a busy refuelling port.

questions.q: Which civil war began in Yemen in 2014?
questions.why: It caused a huge humanitarian crisis.

questions.q: Which Yemeni journalist shared the 2011 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.why: She was the first Arab woman to win it.

questions.q: Who was President of united Yemen from 1990 to 2012?
questions.why: He had led North Yemen since 1978.

questions.q: Which ancient kingdom's capital was Marib?
questions.why: It grew rich from incense.

questions.q: What was the north Yemen state ruled by imams until 1962?
questions.why: A revolution created the Yemen Arab Republic.

questions.q: Which kingdom ruled much of Yemen from about 110 BC to AD 525?
questions.why: Its kings later adopted Judaism.

questions.q: Which South Yemen state existed from 1967 to 1990?
questions.why: It was the Arab world's only Marxist state.

questions.q: Which Yemeni dynasty of the 1200s–1400s built Taiz into a centre of learning?
questions.why: They also wrote on farming and astronomy.

questions.q: Which queen ruled Yemen in the 1000s from Jibla?
questions.why: She ruled for over 50 years.

questions.q: Which ancient city in Hadramawt was a centre of Islamic learning?
questions.why: It has hundreds of mosques.

questions.q: Which coastal town was Yemen's capital under the Ziyadid dynasty and is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It had a famous university.

questions.q: Which strait connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden?
questions.why: Its name means 'Gate of Lamentation'.

questions.q: Which city is Yemen's historic capital?
questions.why: Its old city is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which island with dragon's blood trees belongs to Yemen?
questions.why: A third of its plants are found nowhere else.

questions.q: Which sea lies west of Yemen?
questions.why: The Gulf of Aden lies to the south.

questions.q: Which valley region in the east is home to Shibam and Tarim?
questions.why: It was famous for frankincense.

questions.q: What is Yemen's highest mountain, also the highest in Arabia?
questions.why: It is about 3,666 m high.

questions.q: In which year did North and South Yemen unite?
questions.why: Unity Day is 22 May.

questions.q: Which drink got its name from the Yemeni port of Mocha?
questions.why: Yemen was the first big coffee exporter.

questions.q: Which tall mud-brick towers make Shibam famous?
questions.why: It is called the 'Manhattan of the Desert'.

questions.q: What is Yemen's currency?
questions.why: It has lost much value during the war.

questions.q: Which leaf do many Yemenis chew in the afternoon?
questions.why: It is a mild stimulant.

questions.q: Which curved dagger is worn by Yemeni men?
questions.why: Its handle shows the owner's status.

questions.q: Which bread-and-honey dish is a Yemeni favourite?
questions.why: It is a layered honey cake.

questions.q: Which slow-roasted meat and rice dish comes from Hadramawt?
questions.why: It is cooked in an underground oven.

questions.q: Which stew is called Yemen's national dish?
questions.why: It is topped with fenugreek froth.

questions.q: Which palace is built on top of a rock near Sana'a?
questions.why: It was a summer home of Imam Yahya.
